scripts.dev:sandbox: wrangler pages dev dist --ip 0.0.0.0 --port 3000 --d1 DB --persist-to cloudflare/.wrangler/state --binding JARVISH_ENV=development
scripts.db:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply jarvish-local --local --config cloudflare/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name jarvish --branch main
